title: Prove ambiguous Skill selection fails closed
goal: Ensure Skill selection refuses equally matching Skills instead of arbitrarily selecting one and running the wrong capability.
context: Issue #347 requires the Skill execution path to fail closed on missing, ambiguous, or out-of-scope Skills. SkillRuntime.select has explicit ambiguity branches, but current SkillRuntimeTests do not prove duplicate exact-name matches return noSelection.
forbidden_changes: Do not change Skill selection behavior unless the regression test exposes a failure.
Do not weaken policy, scope checks, cancellation, schema validation, or verification.
Do not modify production runtime, module, workspace, provider, UI, or project files.
acceptance_criteria: Two distinct Skill IDs with the same exact name produce SkillExecutionError.noSelection for that name.
The test uses valid manifests and exercises exact-name ambiguity rather than malformed input.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If the regression fails, inspect only the exact-name ambiguity branch in SkillRuntime.select and make the smallest correction within the approved scope.
